description:
We can use a tool like hashcat to crack user passwords at high speed using GPU acceleration. Practice local password attacks on multiple hash files within your pentesting lab by downloading them at Pentest.TV. What is hashcat? Hashcat is one of the fastest and most advanced password-cracking tools available, widely used by security professionals, penetration testers, and ethical hackers around the world.

Built to leverage the raw power of modern GPUs, hashcat can perform password recovery operations at speeds that far exceed traditional CPU-based crackers, making it the tool of choice when performance matters. Hashcat runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS, and supports a massive range of hashing algorithms — over 300 — including MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, NTLM, bcrypt, WPA/WPA2, Kerberos, and many more.

At its core, hashcat is designed to recover plaintext passwords from captured hashes using a variety of attack modes. These include straight dictionary attacks, combinator attacks, brute force and mask attacks, hybrid attacks, and rule-based attacks that mutate wordlists in highly customizable ways. This flexibility lets analysts tailor their approach to the specific hash type and threat model they're working against.

Hashcat's strength lies in its open-source codebase, active development community, and ability to distribute workloads across multiple GPUs and even networked machines for large-scale cracking operations. It is continuously updated to support new algorithms and to stay ahead of evolving password protection schemes.

Whether you're a penetration tester auditing credential strength, a blue teamer validating your organization's password policies, a forensic examiner recovering evidence, or a cybersecurity learner sharpening your offensive skills, hashcat provides an unmatched platform for password auditing and recovery. Its speed, depth, and versatility make it an essential tool in the arsenal of anyone serious about cybersecurity.
